itens.titulo: Tesla Stocks Fall 1.7% as Roadster Reveal Faces a Revenue Reality Check
itens.descricao: Tesla Stocks Fall 1.7% as Roadster Reveal Faces a Revenue Reality Check Yahoo Finance
trechos: Tesla, the electric-vehicle and autonomy company (NASDAQ:TSLA), heads into tonight's Roadster reveal with shares at $360.86, down approximately 1.71%, as of 12:33 p.m.
GuruFocus has detected 6 Warning Signs with TSLA.
According to Reuters' reporting, the event starts at 8:55 p.m.
ET, and Morningstar analyst Seth Goldstein expects roughly 2,000 Roadsters a year.
That would equal just 0.125% of Tesla's approximately 1.6 million vehicle sales last year.
The valuation leaves little room for empty spectacle: the shares trade 7.33% above the $336.23 GF Value estimate, suggesting the stock offers no discount against that benchmark.
